tours.name: Create an Off-Cycle Payslip for One Employee

name_i18n.en_US: Create an Off-Cycle Payslip for One Employee

tours.description: Learn how to create a payslip outside the regular monthly run for a single employee, for example to pay a correction or a late payment, and compute it.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to create a payslip outside the regular monthly run for a single employee, for example to pay a correction or a late payment, and compute it.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: An off-cycle payslip is a payslip created by hand for one employee, outside the regular monthly batch.

description_i18n.en_US: An off-cycle payslip is a payslip created by hand for one employee, outside the regular monthly batch.

steps.title: Payslips menu
steps.description: The Payslips menu lists the payslips of all employees and is where individual payslips are created.

description_i18n.en_US: The Payslips menu lists the payslips of all employees and is where individual payslips are created.

steps.title: All Payslips
steps.description: This list shows every payslip. From here you can create a new payslip that is not part of a batch.

description_i18n.en_US: This list shows every payslip. From here you can create a new payslip that is not part of a batch.

steps.title: New payslip
steps.content: Click New to create a payslip.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to create a payslip.

steps.description: The New button opens a blank payslip. The period starts and ends on the first and last day of the current month and can be changed.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button opens a blank payslip. The period starts and ends on the first and last day of the current month and can be changed.

steps.title: Employee
steps.content: Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

steps.description: Choose the employee who needs the extra payslip. The contract and the salary structure are filled in from the employee's running contract. Typing narrows the list down; you pick the result in the next step.

description_i18n.en_US: Choose the employee who needs the extra payslip. The contract and the salary structure are filled in from the employee's running contract. Typing narrows the list down; you pick the result in the next step.

steps.validation_message: Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

validation_message_i18n.en_US: Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

steps.title: Choose the employee
steps.content: Click the result you want in the list.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the result you want in the list.

steps.description: Pick the employee concerned. Odoo then loads the employee's contract.

description_i18n.en_US: Pick the employee concerned. Odoo then loads the employee's contract.

steps.title: Salary structure
steps.content: Click here to open the list of salary structures.

content_i18n.en_US: Click here to open the list of salary structures.

steps.description: The structure decides which rules are applied. For a regular payslip use the employee's usual structure. For a one-off payment such as a bonus, choose the structure created for it.

description_i18n.en_US: The structure decides which rules are applied. For a regular payslip use the employee's usual structure. For a one-off payment such as a bonus, choose the structure created for it.

steps.title: Choose the structure
steps.content: Click the result you want in the list.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the result you want in the list.

steps.description: Pick the structure that matches the payment. The payslip will be computed with the rules of this structure.

description_i18n.en_US: Pick the structure that matches the payment. The payslip will be computed with the rules of this structure.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the payslip.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the payslip.

steps.description: Save the payslip so that it can be computed. It stays in Draft until it is computed and confirmed.

description_i18n.en_US: Save the payslip so that it can be computed. It stays in Draft until it is computed and confirmed.

steps.title: Compute Sheet
steps.content: Click Compute Sheet to calculate the payslip.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Compute Sheet to calculate the payslip.

steps.description: Compute Sheet calculates the lines of the payslip from the contract and the structure. After computing, check the Salary Computation tab and confirm the payslip as usual.

description_i18n.en_US: Compute Sheet calculates the lines of the payslip from the contract and the structure. After computing, check the Salary Computation tab and confirm the payslip as usual.
